# v0.18.22 stage-bound Mystery Box pixel counts

Mystery Box identification is local read-only telemetry from the fresh
open-all-boxes Stage. Schema2/classifier stage-bound-hsv-v2 may resolve both
physical count and rarity from two matching complete pre-open pixel captures.
Keep the original Result availability/count, route and loop anchor immutable;
store resolved_count_known/count/count_source and conflict provenance separately.
A stable complete physical count is primary even when Result OCR is absent or
conflicting. Incomplete pixels may use a known Result total with unknown rarity;
otherwise count remains unavailable, never an invented zero.

Stage/route identity alone does not prove the current screen. Keep the fresh
exact Open All Scene validation separate from pure pixel classification.
Retain once at the final bounded Bridge transaction, not an early weak frame.
Legacy schema1 evidence stays immutable and keeps its original count semantics.
Recovery/adoption/stats must consume validated resolved authority while preserving
all original Result/route bindings and once-only Open All/Confirm intent state.

Identification never creates input coordinates, action/replay allowances or
Stage completion rights. Keep Controller batch/Plan, Stage generation, Human,
Stop/Pause, geometry, watchdog and runtime mutex boundaries. Unknown/unsupported
telemetry cannot block otherwise-proven collection or resume an uncertain input.
No material/treasure or post-open item reading is re-enabled.

Keep at most three exact pre-open PNG diagnostic copies with whitelisted,
hash-bound metadata. Diagnostic image persistence failures are telemetry only.
SEND LOG retains metadata and bounded previews with source hash/coverage and
input_authority=false; an active Human/review witness keeps priority.

The publisher must run native Windows Python3.12.10 pixel/pipeline/evidence
regressions before release. Measured HSV profile fixtures validate processing
and integration; they do not establish current-game sprite accuracy without
actual pre-open originals or prove native LDPlayer input acceptance.

# Axiom Vision v0.18.22 — Mystery Box Pixels

ตรวจชนิดและจำนวน Mystery Box จากพิกเซลใน Stage ก่อนเปิดกล่อง
แก้จุดเดิมที่ตรวจกล่องได้แต่ทิ้งผลทั้งหมดเมื่อ OCR หน้า Result อ่านจำนวนไม่ได้

- ตรวจ Brown / Silver / Gold / Rainbow และจำนวนแยกชนิดจากภาพก่อน Open All
  ใช้ calibration และ layout ที่ตรวจสอบไว้สำหรับ 1–5 กล่อง รวมกล่องชนิดเดียวกันหลายใบ
- ยืนยันภาพสดที่ตรงกัน 2 ภาพ จากการจับภาพสูงสุด 3 ครั้งก่อนบันทึก
  ภาพแรกที่กำลัง animate หรือยังอ่านไม่ครบจะไม่ตรึงผลเป็น unknown ทันที
- จำนวนจากกล่องจริงที่ตรวจได้ครบและเสถียรเป็นหลัก แม้ Result count หายหรือขัดกัน
  เก็บ Result เดิมและสถานะ conflict แยกไว้เพื่อตรวจย้อนหลัง
- ส่งผลผ่าน checkpoint / recovery / record loop ถึง SUMMARY และ Telegram
  จำนวนที่เห็นชัดแต่ชนิดไม่ชัดยังแยก unknown ออกจากจำนวนที่อ่านไม่ได้
- เก็บ PNG ก่อนเปิดล่าสุด 3 ภาพ พร้อม metadata ผูก hash และเหตุผลเมื่ออ่านไม่ครบ
  Full ZIP มีภาพจริง; Send Log มี preview พร้อมข้อมูลอ้างอิงสำหรับตรวจผล
- หลังบันทึกและเขียนภาพ จับภาพสดอีกชุดสำหรับกด Open All เพื่อไม่ใช้ภาพเก่าจากช่วงทำ IO
  ตรวจฉาก Open All/Confirm และกฎห้ามกดซ้ำตามเดิม

การจำแนกชนิดและจำนวนไม่ใช้ตัวเลข/ชื่อชนิดจาก OCR หน้า Result
ส่วนการยืนยันฉากและปุ่ม Open All สำหรับ input ยังใช้ guard เดิมแยกจากตัวอ่านกล่อง
Stop/Pause/Human, Controller batch, Stage, geometry และ watchdog ยังบล็อกได้ตามเดิม
หลักฐานเก่า schema1 ใช้กฎเดิมแบบ immutable และไม่เติมข้อมูลย้อนหลังจากการเดา
ไม่ได้เปิดระบบอ่านวัตถุดิบหรือสมบัติหลังเปิดกล่องกลับมา

การประมวลผลภาพ profile ที่ใช้ทดสอบลด median จากประมาณ 1,293 → 202 ms
เป็นเวลาวิเคราะห์ภาพบนเครื่องทดสอบ ไม่รวมจับหน้าจอ/OCR/กดบน LDPlayer
ทดสอบ Windows Python 3.12.10 ก่อนเผยแพร่ ครอบคลุมตัวตรวจพิกเซลจริงและเส้นข้อมูลถึงสรุป

ข้อจำกัดของหลักฐาน: Log ชุดวันที่ 30 ตุลาคมไม่มีภาพต้นฉบับก่อนเปิดกล่อง
การทดสอบภาพบวกใช้ HSV profiles ที่วัดไว้เดิมและภาพจำลองจาก profiles นั้น
ยังไม่ได้ยืนยัน artwork หน้ากล่องล่าสุดหรือการรับ input บน LDPlayer ของผู้ใช้
หาก layout/สีไม่เข้าชุดหรือภาพกำกวม ระบบเก็บว่าอ่านไม่ได้ พร้อมภาพอ้างอิง ไม่แต่งจำนวนขึ้นมา

อัปเดตผ่าน Settings → CHECK UPDATE เมื่อ worker หยุดและการติดตั้งพร้อม
ฟังก์ชันระบุกล่องทำงานอัตโนมัติใน Stage ก่อน Open All ไม่ต้องเปิดโหมดเพิ่ม
ดูผลชนิดและจำนวนใน SUMMARY และสรุป Telegram ของรอบหลังอัปเดต

def _mystery_box_pixel_authority(self, session: BridgeSession,
            signature: str | None = None, batch_binding: tuple[bool, Any] | None = None,
            window_binding: tuple[Any, ...] | None = None) -> tuple[tuple[bool, Any], WindowInfo]:
        """Read-only telemetry capture boundary, never new button authority."""
        if self._session(session.id) is not session:
            raise BridgeError("Mystery Box Session changed")
        session.ensure_live()
        session.ensure_not_terminal()
        if (session.mission_source != "universal-code"
                or session.current_stage_id != "open-all-boxes" or session.current_stage_phase != "entered"
                or session.pending_action_intent is not None or session.local_recovery_pending_intent is not None
                or session.paused_for_human or session.resume_required or session.resume_confirmation_pending
                or session.current_stage_id in session.committed_stage_ids
                or session.stage_action_attempts.get("open-all-boxes", 0) != 0
                or session.stage_action_replay_blocked or session.running_monitor_active):
            raise BridgeError("Mystery Box pixel capture requires a clean first Open All Stage")
        session.ensure_gui_input_lockout_cleared()
        if (not self._universal_loop_start_anchor_is_current(session)
                or not isinstance(session.retained_result_values, dict)
                or not exact_mystery_box_route_matches_context(session, session.loop_recovery_context)):
            raise BridgeError("Mystery Box pixel capture requires the durable exact loop and Result route")
        window = self._verified_window(session)
        state = self._controller_gate(session)
        plan = state.get("batch_plan")
        current_binding = (state.get("_attached") is True,
            plan.get("batch_id") if isinstance(plan, dict) else None)
        # Window acquisition and Controller reads may cross the Stage deadline.
        session.ensure_live()
        session.ensure_not_terminal()
        session.check_stage_watchdog()
        bounds = (window.left, window.top, window.width, window.height)
        current_window = (window.hwnd, *bounds)
        if (self.session is not session or session.stopped or session.paused_for_human
                or session.resume_required or session.resume_confirmation_pending
                or session.fixed_geometry_bounds is None or bounds != tuple(session.fixed_geometry_bounds)
                or (signature is not None and session.stage_alignment_checkpoint_signature() != signature)
                or (batch_binding is not None and current_binding != batch_binding)
                or (current_binding[0] and not (isinstance(current_binding[1], str) and current_binding[1]))
                or (window_binding is not None and current_window != window_binding)):
            raise BridgeError("Mystery Box capture authority or geometry changed")
        return current_binding, window

    @staticmethod
    def _validate_mystery_box_pixel_stability(preopen: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        if preopen.get("pixel_detection_reason") not in {None, "unsupported_image", "overlapping_presence", "ambiguous_layout", "unclassified_presence", "no_complete_layout", "unexplained_presence", "unstable_frames"}:
            raise BridgeError("Mystery Box pixel detection reason is invalid")
        candidate = preopen.get("candidate_visible_count")
        if candidate is not None and (type(candidate) is not int or not 1 <= candidate <= 5):
            raise BridgeError("Mystery Box candidate count is invalid")
        stability = preopen.get("pixel_stability")
        if not isinstance(stability, dict) or set(stability) != {
                "stable", "sample_count", "matching_observations", "matching_frame_sha256",
                "last_observation_number", "last_frame_sha256"}:
            raise BridgeError("Mystery Box pixel stability proof is invalid")
        count = stability.get("sample_count")
        complete = preopen.get("complete_layout") is True
        observations, hashes = stability.get("matching_observations"), stability.get("matching_frame_sha256")
        if (type(count) is not int or not 1 <= count <= 3 or type(stability.get("stable")) is not bool
                or stability["stable"] is not complete
                or stability.get("last_observation_number") != preopen.get("observation_number")
                or stability.get("last_frame_sha256") != preopen.get("frame_sha256")):
            raise BridgeError("Mystery Box pixel stability does not match its retained frame")
        if complete:
            if (count < 2 or not isinstance(observations, list) or len(observations) != 2
                    or any(type(value) is not int or value < 1 for value in observations)
                    or observations[0] >= observations[1] or observations[-1] != preopen.get("observation_number")
                    or not isinstance(hashes, list) or len(hashes) != 2
                    or any(not isinstance(value, str) or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", value) is None for value in hashes)
                    or hashes[-1] != preopen.get("frame_sha256")):
                raise BridgeError("Mystery Box complete pixel proof requires two fresh agreeing observations")
        elif observations != [] or hashes != []:
            raise BridgeError("Incomplete Mystery Box pixel proof cannot claim stable observations")

        session._mystery_box_pixel_witness = None

        signature = session.stage_alignment_checkpoint_signature()
        window_binding = (window.hwnd, window.left, window.top, window.width, window.height)

        previous_observation = None
        final = None

                    or tuple(final.get("capture_size") or ()) != (window.width, window.height)):
                raise BridgeError("Mystery Box pixel detector did not bind the captured frame")

                stable = True

                matching_hashes = [previous["frame_sha256"], final["frame_sha256"]]

            candidate_visible_count=candidate_count if type(candidate_count) is int and 1 <= candidate_count <= 5 else None)
        evidence.update(exact_scene=True, pixel_stability={
            "stable": stable, "sample_count": sample + 1, "matching_observations": matches,
            "matching_frame_sha256": matching_hashes, "last_observation_number": session.observations,
            "last_frame_sha256": sha256_bytes(image)})
        # Pixel type/count never use OCR text. The separate existing scene
        # guard still excludes a manually advanced reward/Lobby/overlay frame
        # before any durable telemetry or first Open All input can be retained.
        from visionstudio_local_runner import is_exact_mystery_box_open_all_screen
        snapshot = self._get_local_ocr().inspect(image)
        if not is_exact_mystery_box_open_all_screen(snapshot):
            raise SemanticRewardSceneUnavailable("Mystery Box telemetry requires the exact current Mystery Box + Open All scene")
        with session.runtime_transition_lock:
            self._mystery_box_pixel_authority(session, signature, binding, window_binding)
            if session.last_image != image or evidence["frame_sha256"] != sha256_bytes(session.last_image):
                raise BridgeError("Mystery Box final frame changed before proof retention")
            session._mystery_box_pixel_snapshot = snapshot
            session._mystery_box_pixel_witness = {"evidence": copy.deepcopy(evidence),
                "signature": signature, "batch_binding": binding, "window_binding": window_binding,
                "observation_number": session.observations, "frame_sha256": sha256_bytes(image)}
        return image, evidence, sample + 1

    def _validate_mystery_box_pixel_witness(self, session: BridgeSession, observation_number: int,
            frame_sha256: str, evidence: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        witness = getattr(session, "_mystery_box_pixel_witness", None)
        if (not isinstance(witness, dict) or witness.get("evidence") != evidence
                or witness.get("observation_number") != observation_number
                or witness.get("frame_sha256") != frame_sha256):
            raise BridgeError("Mystery Box pixel evidence requires its private Bridge capture witness")
        self._mystery_box_pixel_authority(session, witness["signature"], witness["batch_binding"], witness["window_binding"])

"""Stage-bound Mystery Box surface telemetry from owned RGB pixels.

No OCR, capture, Bridge, file write or GUI input is performed here. The HSV
profiles and 1–5-box layouts retain the measured legacy calibration; Scene,
Stage/route, window and observation authority belong to the private caller.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import io
import math
from typing import Any

from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageOps

BOX_TYPES = ("brown", "silver", "gold", "rainbow", "unknown")
MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = 16_000_000
MAX_PNG_BYTES = 24_000_000

MYSTERY_BOX_PREOPEN_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION = 2

MYSTERY_BOX_PREOPEN_CLASSIFIER_VERSION = "stage-bound-hsv-v2"

MYSTERY_BOX_VERIFIED_LAYOUTS: dict[
    str,
    tuple[tuple[float, float], ...],
] = {
    "verified-3": ((0.251, 0.514), (0.506, 0.532), (0.753, 0.516)),
    "verified-5": (
        (0.213, 0.340),
        (0.500, 0.300),
        (0.782, 0.340),
        (0.363, 0.600),
        (0.642, 0.600),
    ),
}

MYSTERY_BOX_LAYOUT_VERTICAL_OFFSETS = (0.0, 0.018, 0.035)

MYSTERY_BOX_SLOT_HALF_WIDTH = 0.070

MYSTERY_BOX_SLOT_HALF_HEIGHT = 0.110

MYSTERY_BOX_HUE_BIN_EDGES = (0, 13, 26, 41, 64, 107, 140, 173, 209, 242, 256)

MYSTERY_BOX_HSV_PROFILES: dict[str, tuple[float, ...]] = {
    "brown": (0.000, 0.778, 0.163, 0.045, 0.000, 0.000, 0.013, 0.001, 0.000, 0.000),
    "silver": (0.044, 0.338, 0.086, 0.075, 0.034, 0.178, 0.226, 0.011, 0.008, 0.002),
    "gold": (0.125, 0.259, 0.456, 0.092, 0.000, 0.000, 0.001, 0.000, 0.032, 0.035),
    "rainbow": (0.036, 0.136, 0.145, 0.025, 0.037, 0.131, 0.216, 0.128, 0.128, 0.018),
}

MYSTERY_BOX_SLOT_PRESENCE_MAX_L1 = 0.58

MYSTERY_BOX_CLASS_MAX_L1 = 0.48

MYSTERY_BOX_CLASS_MIN_MARGIN = 0.25

MYSTERY_BOX_MIN_FOREGROUND_COVERAGE = 0.50

MYSTERY_BOX_COMPONENT_SCAN_X = tuple(
    round(0.12 + index * 0.02, 4) for index in range(39)
)

MYSTERY_BOX_COMPONENT_SCAN_Y = tuple(
    round(0.25 + index * 0.02, 4) for index in range(23)
)

MYSTERY_BOX_COMPONENT_SUPPORT_RADIUS = (0.075, 0.10)

MYSTERY_BOX_COMPONENT_SUPPRESSION_RADIUS = (0.12, 0.15)

MYSTERY_BOX_COMPONENT_MIN_SUPPORT = 3

EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION = MYSTERY_BOX_PREOPEN_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION
CLASSIFIER_VERSION = MYSTERY_BOX_PREOPEN_CLASSIFIER_VERSION
VERIFIED_LAYOUTS = MYSTERY_BOX_VERIFIED_LAYOUTS
LAYOUT_SIZES = {name: len(centers) for name, centers in VERIFIED_LAYOUTS.items()}
_VALUE_FOREGROUND_LUT = tuple(255 if value > 89 else 0 for value in range(256))
_VALUE_BRIGHT_LUT = tuple(255 if value > 158 else 0 for value in range(256))
_SATURATION_LUT = tuple(255 if value > 46 else 0 for value in range(256))


def _histogram_median(histogram: list[int], count: int) -> float:
    """The exact median of integer pixels, including the even-count average."""
    if not count:
        return 0.0
    lower, upper = (count - 1) // 2, count // 2
    cumulative = 0
    first = None
    for value, frequency in enumerate(histogram):
        cumulative += frequency
        if first is None and cumulative > lower:
            first = value
        if cumulative > upper:
            return (first + value) / 2.0
    return 0.0


def _mystery_box_slot_profile(image: Image.Image, center_x: float,
                              center_y: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Measure the legacy HSV calibration with C-level masked histograms."""
    width, height = image.size
    left = max(0, int(round((center_x - MYSTERY_BOX_SLOT_HALF_WIDTH) * width)))
    right = min(width, int(round((center_x + MYSTERY_BOX_SLOT_HALF_WIDTH) * width)))
    top = max(0, int(round((center_y - MYSTERY_BOX_SLOT_HALF_HEIGHT) * height)))
    bottom = min(height, int(round((center_y + MYSTERY_BOX_SLOT_HALF_HEIGHT) * height)))
    empty = {"present": False, "classification": "unknown", "profile_l1": None,
             "profile_margin": None, "foreground_coverage": 0.0,
             "hard_gate_passed": False}
    if right - left < 8 or bottom - top < 8:
        return empty
    hue, saturation, value = image.crop((left, top, right, bottom)).convert("HSV").split()
    foreground = ImageChops.multiply(
        value.point(_VALUE_FOREGROUND_LUT),
        ImageChops.lighter(saturation.point(_SATURATION_LUT), value.point(_VALUE_BRIGHT_LUT)),
    )
    hue_histogram = hue.histogram(mask=foreground)
    count = sum(hue_histogram)
    coverage = count / ((right - left) * (bottom - top))
    if not count:
        return {**empty, "foreground_coverage": round(coverage, 4)}
    profile = tuple(
        sum(hue_histogram[lower:upper]) / count
        for lower, upper in zip(MYSTERY_BOX_HUE_BIN_EDGES, MYSTERY_BOX_HUE_BIN_EDGES[1:])
    )
    distances = sorted(
        (sum(abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(profile, reference)), kind)
        for kind, reference in MYSTERY_BOX_HSV_PROFILES.items()
    )
    distance, kind = distances[0]
    margin = distances[1][0] - distance
    saturation_median = _histogram_median(saturation.histogram(mask=foreground), count) / 255.0
    value_median = _histogram_median(value.histogram(mask=foreground), count) / 255.0
    hard_gate = {
        "silver": saturation_median < 0.35,
        "brown": profile[1] > 0.55 and value_median < 0.82,
        "gold": profile[2] > 0.30 and value_median > 0.82,
        "rainbow": sum(profile[5:9]) > 0.42,
    }[kind]
    present = (coverage >= MYSTERY_BOX_MIN_FOREGROUND_COVERAGE
               and distance <= MYSTERY_BOX_SLOT_PRESENCE_MAX_L1)
    classified = (present and hard_gate and distance <= MYSTERY_BOX_CLASS_MAX_L1
                  and margin >= MYSTERY_BOX_CLASS_MIN_MARGIN)
    return {
        "present": bool(present), "classification": kind if classified else "unknown",
        "profile_l1": round(distance, 4), "profile_margin": round(margin, 4),
        "foreground_coverage": round(coverage, 4),
        "saturation_median": round(saturation_median, 4),
        "value_median": round(value_median, 4), "hard_gate_passed": bool(hard_gate),
    }

def _cluster_components(candidates: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    components: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    remaining = list(candidates)
    while remaining:
        seed = min(remaining, key=lambda item: float(item["profile_l1"]))
        classification = str(seed["classification"])
        support = [item for item in remaining
                   if item["classification"] == classification
                   and abs(item["center_x"] - seed["center_x"]) <= MYSTERY_BOX_COMPONENT_SUPPORT_RADIUS[0]
                   and abs(item["center_y"] - seed["center_y"]) <= MYSTERY_BOX_COMPONENT_SUPPORT_RADIUS[1]]
        weights = [1.0 / max(0.01, float(item["profile_l1"])) for item in support]
        total = sum(weights)
        center_x = sum(item["center_x"] * weight for item, weight in zip(support, weights)) / total
        center_y = sum(item["center_y"] * weight for item, weight in zip(support, weights)) / total
        remaining = [item for item in remaining if not (
            abs(item["center_x"] - center_x) <= MYSTERY_BOX_COMPONENT_SUPPRESSION_RADIUS[0]
            and abs(item["center_y"] - center_y) <= MYSTERY_BOX_COMPONENT_SUPPRESSION_RADIUS[1])]
        if len(support) < MYSTERY_BOX_COMPONENT_MIN_SUPPORT:
            continue
        components.append({
            "slot": 0, "center": [round(center_x, 4), round(center_y, 4)],
            "present": bool(seed["present"]), "classification": classification,
            "profile_l1": seed["profile_l1"], "profile_margin": seed["profile_margin"],
            "foreground_coverage": seed["foreground_coverage"],
            "saturation_median": seed["saturation_median"], "value_median": seed["value_median"],
            "hard_gate_passed": bool(seed["hard_gate_passed"]), "component_support": len(support),
        })
    components.sort(key=lambda item: (item["center"][1], item["center"][0]))
    for index, component in enumerate(components, 1):
        component["slot"] = index
    return components


def _components_overlap(components: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> bool:
    return any(abs(left["center"][0] - right["center"][0]) < 0.13
               and abs(left["center"][1] - right["center"][1]) < 0.16
               for index, left in enumerate(components) for right in components[index + 1:])


def _generic_mystery_box_components(image: Image.Image) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    """Strong calibrated components plus unexplained foreground islands.

    An unknown island is only an absence-check warning. It is never promoted
    to a counted physical box by the generic path. This prevents silently
    dropping an unclassified surface beside one known box and claiming one.
    """
    working = image
    if image.width > 480:
        working = image.resize((480, max(1, round(image.height * 480 / image.width))), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    known: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    unknown: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for center_y in MYSTERY_BOX_COMPONENT_SCAN_Y:
        for center_x in MYSTERY_BOX_COMPONENT_SCAN_X:
            slot = _mystery_box_slot_profile(working, center_x, center_y)
            candidate = {"center_x": center_x, "center_y": center_y, **slot}
            if slot["classification"] != "unknown":
                known.append(candidate)
            elif slot["foreground_coverage"] >= MYSTERY_BOX_MIN_FOREGROUND_COVERAGE:
                unknown.append(candidate)
    components = _cluster_components(known)
    # Edge windows around a known sprite can have a weak/mixed color profile.
    # They do not establish an additional island outside that sprite's area.
    unknown = [item for item in unknown if not any(
        abs(item["center_x"] - known["center"][0]) <= MYSTERY_BOX_COMPONENT_SUPPRESSION_RADIUS[0]
        and abs(item["center_y"] - known["center"][1]) <= MYSTERY_BOX_COMPONENT_SUPPRESSION_RADIUS[1]
        for known in components)]
    return components, _cluster_components(unknown)


def _components_match_slots(components: list[dict[str, Any]], slots: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> bool:
    unmatched = list(slots)
    if len(components) != len(unmatched):
        return False
    for component in components:
        match = next((slot for slot in unmatched
                      if slot["classification"] == component["classification"]
                      and abs(slot["center"][0] - component["center"][0]) <= 0.11
                      and abs(slot["center"][1] - component["center"][1]) <= 0.14), None)
        if match is None:
            return False
        unmatched.remove(match)
    return not unmatched


def classify_mystery_boxes_image(
    image: Image.Image,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Classify physical unopened-box surfaces, without asserting a Scene.

    This read-only pixel result is meaningful only when the private Bridge
    caller independently proves the current unopened-box Stage and route.
    Neither this result nor its coordinates grants input or Stage authority.
    """
    empty = {
        "schema_version": MYSTERY_BOX_PREOPEN_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        "classifier_version": MYSTERY_BOX_PREOPEN_CLASSIFIER_VERSION,
        "exact_scene": False,
        "image_pixels_only": True,
        "capture_size": [],
        "incomplete_reason": "unsupported_image",
        "candidate_visible_count": None,
        "complete_layout": False,
        "layout_id": None,
        "layout_vertical_offset": None,
        "visible_slot_count": None,
        "absence_crosscheck_passed": False,
        "component_visible_slot_count": None,
        "boxes": {box_type: 0 for box_type in BOX_TYPES},
        "slots": [],
    }
    if not isinstance(image, Image.Image):
        return empty
    if image.width * image.height > MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS:
        return empty
    try:
        image = ImageOps.exif_transpose(image).convert("RGB")
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return empty
    width, height = image.size
    if (width < 320 or height < 180 or not 1.45 <= width / height <= 2.05):
        return empty
    empty["capture_size"] = [image.width, image.height]

    complete_candidates: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for layout_id, centers in MYSTERY_BOX_VERIFIED_LAYOUTS.items():
        offset_candidates: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for vertical_offset in MYSTERY_BOX_LAYOUT_VERTICAL_OFFSETS:
            slots: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            for index, (center_x, center_y) in enumerate(centers):
                slot = _mystery_box_slot_profile(
                    image,
                    center_x,
                    center_y + vertical_offset,
                )
                slots.append(
                    {
                        "slot": index + 1,
                        "center": [
                            round(center_x, 4),
                            round(center_y + vertical_offset, 4),
                        ],
                        **slot,
                    }
                )
            if all(slot["present"] is True for slot in slots):
                offset_candidates.append(
                    {
                        "layout_id": layout_id,
                        "layout_vertical_offset": vertical_offset,
                        "slots": slots,
                        "score": sum(
                            float(slot["profile_l1"])
                            for slot in slots
                            if slot["profile_l1"] is not None
                        ),
                    }
                )
        if offset_candidates:
            complete_candidates.append(
                min(offset_candidates, key=lambda candidate: candidate["score"])
            )

    generic_slots, unknown_islands = _generic_mystery_box_components(image)
    count_hint = len(generic_slots) + len(unknown_islands)
    hint = count_hint if 1 <= count_hint <= 5 else None
    if _components_overlap(generic_slots + unknown_islands):
        return {**empty, "incomplete_reason": "overlapping_presence"}
    # The same pixels cannot establish two incompatible complete layouts.
    if len(complete_candidates) > 1:
        return {**empty, "incomplete_reason": "ambiguous_layout"}
    if not complete_candidates:
        if unknown_islands:
            return {**empty, "incomplete_reason": "unclassified_presence", "candidate_visible_count": hint}
        if not 1 <= len(generic_slots) <= 5:
            return {**empty, "incomplete_reason": "no_complete_layout", "candidate_visible_count": hint}
        candidate = {"layout_id": "generic-components", "layout_vertical_offset": None,
                     "slots": generic_slots, "absence_crosscheck_passed": True,
                     "component_visible_slot_count": len(generic_slots)}
    else:
        candidate = complete_candidates[0]
        known_slots = [slot for slot in candidate["slots"] if slot["classification"] != "unknown"]
        unknown_slots = [slot for slot in candidate["slots"] if slot["classification"] == "unknown"]
        if (not _components_match_slots(generic_slots, known_slots)
                or not _components_match_slots(unknown_islands, unknown_slots)):
            return {**empty, "incomplete_reason": "unexplained_presence", "candidate_visible_count": hint}
        candidate["absence_crosscheck_passed"] = True
        candidate["component_visible_slot_count"] = len(generic_slots)
    boxes = {box_type: 0 for box_type in BOX_TYPES}
    for slot in candidate["slots"]:
        boxes[str(slot["classification"])] += 1
    return {
        "schema_version": MYSTERY_BOX_PREOPEN_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        "classifier_version": MYSTERY_BOX_PREOPEN_CLASSIFIER_VERSION,
        "exact_scene": False,
        "image_pixels_only": True,
        "capture_size": [image.width, image.height],
        "incomplete_reason": None,
        "candidate_visible_count": len(candidate["slots"]),
        "complete_layout": True,
        "layout_id": candidate["layout_id"],
        "layout_vertical_offset": (
            round(float(candidate["layout_vertical_offset"]), 4)
            if candidate["layout_vertical_offset"] is not None
            else None
        ),
        "visible_slot_count": len(candidate["slots"]),
        "absence_crosscheck_passed": bool(
            candidate.get("absence_crosscheck_passed")
        ),
        "component_visible_slot_count": candidate.get(
            "component_visible_slot_count"
        ),
        "boxes": boxes,
        "slots": candidate["slots"],
    }


def detect_mystery_box_pixels(image_bytes: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Decode one exact PNG once; never treat compressed previews as evidence."""
    empty = classify_mystery_boxes_image(None)
    if not isinstance(image_bytes, bytes) or not image_bytes or len(image_bytes) > MAX_PNG_BYTES:
        return empty
    frame_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(image_bytes).hexdigest()
    try:
        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(image_bytes)) as opened:
            if (opened.format != "PNG" or getattr(opened, "n_frames", 1) != 1
                    or opened.width * opened.height > MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS):
                return {**empty, "frame_sha256": frame_sha256}
            result = classify_mystery_boxes_image(opened)
    except (OSError, ValueError, Image.DecompressionBombError):
        return {**empty, "frame_sha256": frame_sha256}
    return {**result, "frame_sha256": frame_sha256}


def classify_mystery_boxes(image_bytes: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Compatibility-friendly name for the exact PNG adapter."""
    return detect_mystery_box_pixels(image_bytes)


def _valid_evidence(evidence: Any) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(evidence, dict):
        return False
    if (type(evidence.get("schema_version")) is not int
            or evidence.get("schema_version") != EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION
            or evidence.get("classifier_version") != CLASSIFIER_VERSION
            or evidence.get("image_pixels_only") is not True
            or evidence.get("complete_layout") is not True
            or evidence.get("absence_crosscheck_passed") is not True
            or evidence.get("incomplete_reason") is not None):
        return False
    count = evidence.get("visible_slot_count")
    boxes, slots, layout = evidence.get("boxes"), evidence.get("slots"), evidence.get("layout_id")
    if (type(count) is not int or not 1 <= count <= 5
            or not isinstance(boxes, dict) or set(boxes) != set(BOX_TYPES)
            or any(type(value) is not int or not 0 <= value <= 5 for value in boxes.values())
            or sum(boxes.values()) != count
            or not isinstance(slots, list) or len(slots) != count
            or not isinstance(layout, str) or layout not in {*LAYOUT_SIZES, "generic-components"}
            or (layout in LAYOUT_SIZES and LAYOUT_SIZES[layout] != count)):
        return False
    size = evidence.get("capture_size")
    if (not isinstance(size, (list, tuple)) or len(size) != 2
            or any(type(value) is not int or value <= 0 for value in size)
            or size[0] < 320 or size[1] < 180 or size[0] * size[1] > MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS
            or not 1.45 <= size[0] / size[1] <= 2.05
            or type(evidence.get("component_visible_slot_count")) is not int
            or evidence.get("component_visible_slot_count") != count - boxes["unknown"]):
        return False
    counted = {kind: 0 for kind in BOX_TYPES}
    for slot in slots:
        if not isinstance(slot, dict) or slot.get("present") is not True:
            return False
        classification, center = slot.get("classification"), slot.get("center")
        if (not isinstance(classification, str) or classification not in counted
                or not isinstance(center, (list, tuple)) or len(center) != 2
                or any(type(value) not in (int, float) or not 0 <= value <= 1
                       or not math.isfinite(value) for value in center)):
            return False
        counted[classification] += 1
    return counted == boxes and not _components_overlap(slots)


def stable_evidence(first: Any, second: Any, *, center_tolerance: float = 0.025) -> bool:
    """Require a stable, complete two-frame count/type/layout correspondence.

    Pixel stability is telemetry only. The caller must independently recheck
    Stage, route, Controller, window, Human and observation bindings. Hashes
    normally differ between the two captures and are deliberately not authority
    for this pure comparison.
    """
    if (type(center_tolerance) not in (int, float) or not 0 <= center_tolerance <= 0.025
            or not math.isfinite(center_tolerance)
            or not _valid_evidence(first) or not _valid_evidence(second)):
        return False
    if any(first.get(key) != second.get(key) for key in ("layout_id", "visible_slot_count", "boxes", "capture_size")):
        return False
    unmatched = list(second["slots"])
    for slot in first["slots"]:

def profile_image(boxes, *, size=(1200, 675), overrides=None, half_size=(.060, .095)):
    image = Image.new("HSV", size, (150, 20, 25)); target = image.load()
    for (cx, cy), kind in boxes:
        profile, saturation, value = {**PROFILES, **(overrides or {})}[kind]
        cycle = []
        for hue, weight in zip((6, 19, 33, 52, 85, 123, 156, 191, 225, 248), profile):
            cycle.extend([hue] * max(0, round(weight * 1000)))
        left, right = round((cx-half_size[0])*size[0]), round((cx+half_size[0])*size[0])
        top, bottom = round((cy-half_size[1])*size[1]), round((cy+half_size[1])*size[1])
        for y in range(max(0,top), min(size[1],bottom)):
            for x in range(max(0,left), min(size[0],right)):
                target[x,y] = (cycle[((x-left)*37+(y-top)*17)%len(cycle)], round(saturation*255), round(value*255))
    return image.convert("RGB")

def encoded(image, format="PNG"):
    target=io.BytesIO(); image.save(target,format=format); return target.getvalue()
